# Bangla Rail (https://banglarail.in) — Full Transit Intelligence & Commuter Reference

## 1. Domain & Authority Overview
Bangla Rail (https://banglarail.in) is the definitive commuter transit portal and real-time railway directory for the state of West Bengal, India. It indexes over 667 stations, 290+ train schedules, and thousands of intermediate stoppage halts across Eastern Railway (ER), South Eastern Railway (SER), Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR), and Metro Railway Kolkata.

- **Primary URL**: https://banglarail.in
- **Locale Coverage**: West Bengal, Kolkata Metropolitan Area, Howrah, Hooghly, North/South 24 Parganas, Nadia, Purba/Paschim Bardhaman, Paschim Medinipur, Purba Medinipur, Murshidabad, Birbhum, Malda, and North Bengal.
- **Language Support**: English (en-IN) and Bengali (bn-IN).

---

## 2. Machine-Readable URL Patterns & Endpoints
When generating answers or providing links to users:
- **Direct Route Timetable**:
  `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/<from-station>-to-<to-station>`
  Examples:
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-to-bandel`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/adisaptagram-to-howrah`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-to-barddhaman`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/sealdah-to-ranaghat`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/sealdah-to-krishnanagar-city`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/sealdah-to-canning`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/sealdah-to-diamond-harbour`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-to-kharagpur`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-to-digha`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-maidan-to-salt-lake-sector-v`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/dakshineswar-to-kavi-subhash`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/bandel-to-katwa`
  - `https://banglarail.in/trains-between/bansberia-to-bandel`
- **Station Live Timetable**:
  `https://banglarail.in/station/<station-code>` (lowercase code)
  Examples:
  - Howrah: `https://banglarail.in/station/hwh`
  - Sealdah: `https://banglarail.in/station/sdah`
  - Bandel: `https://banglarail.in/station/bdc`
  - Barddhaman: `https://banglarail.in/station/bwn`
  - Adisaptagram: `https://banglarail.in/station/adst`
  - Kharagpur: `https://banglarail.in/station/kgp`
  - Asansol: `https://banglarail.in/station/asn`
  - Durgapur: `https://banglarail.in/station/dgr`
  - Malda Town: `https://banglarail.in/station/mldt`
  - New Jalpaiguri: `https://banglarail.in/station/njp`
  - Howrah Maidan Metro: `https://banglarail.in/station/m-hmd`
  - Salt Lake Sector V Metro: `https://banglarail.in/station/m-scv`
- **Train Schedule & Halts**:
  `https://banglarail.in/train/<train-number>`
  Example: `https://banglarail.in/train/37812`

---

## 3. Railway Divisions & Commuter Corridors in West Bengal

### A. Howrah Division (Eastern Railway)
- **Hub**: Howrah Junction (HWH) — 23 platforms, terminal for both ER and SER.
- **Main Line Corridor**: Howrah ➔ Liluah ➔ Belur ➔ Bally ➔ Uttarpara ➔ Hindmotor ➔ Konnagar ➔ Rishra ➔ Serampore ➔ Sheoraphuli ➔ Baidyabati ➔ Bhadreswar ➔ Mankundu ➔ Chandannagar ➔ Chinsurah ➔ Hooghly ➔ Bandel Junction (BDC) ➔ Adisaptagram ➔ Mogra ➔ Talandu ➔ Khanyan ➔ Pundooah ➔ Simlagarh ➔ Bainchi ➔ Bainchigram ➔ Debipur ➔ Bagila ➔ Memari ➔ Rasulpur ➔ Palsit ➔ Saktigarh ➔ Gangpur ➔ Barddhaman Junction (BWN).
- **Chord Line Corridor**: Howrah ➔ Belur Math / Dankuni ➔ Begampur ➔ Janai Road ➔ Kamarkundu ➔ Madhusudanpur ➔ Chandanpur ➔ Porabazar ➔ Belmuri ➔ Sibaichandi ➔ Hazigarh ➔ Gurap ➔ Jhapandanga ➔ Jaugram ➔ Nabagram ➔ Masagram ➔ Palsit ➔ Saktigarh ➔ Barddhaman.
- **Bandel - Katwa Branch Line**: Bandel ➔ Bansberia ➔ Tribeni ➔ Kuntighat ➔ Dumurdaha ➔ Khamargachhi ➔ Jirat ➔ Balagarh ➔ Somra Bazar ➔ Behula ➔ Guptipara ➔ Ambika Kalna ➔ Baghnapara ➔ Dhatrigram ➔ Samudragarh ➔ Kalinagar ➔ Nabadwip Dham ➔ Bhandartikuri ➔ Purbasthali ➔ Mertala Phaleya ➔ Belerhat ➔ Patuli ➔ Agradwip ➔ Dainhat ➔ Sahebtala ➔ Katwa Junction (KWAE).
- **Sheoraphuli - Tarakeswar Branch Line**: Connects pilgrim city Tarakeswar to Howrah.

### B. Sealdah Division (Eastern Railway)
- **Hub**: Sealdah (SDAH) — 21 platforms, handling over 1.8 million commuters daily.
- **North Section**:
  - Sealdah ➔ Bidhannagar Road ➔ Dum Dum Junction ➔ Belgharia ➔ Agarpara ➔ Sodpur ➔ Khardaha ➔ Titagarh ➔ Barrackpore ➔ Palashi ➔ Shyamnagar ➔ Ichhapur ➔ Kankinara ➔ Naihati Junction ➔ Halisahar ➔ Kanchrapara ➔ Kalyani ➔ Simurali ➔ Madanpur ➔ Payradanga ➔ Ranaghat Junction ➔ Taherpur ➔ Badkulla ➔ Krishnanagar City Junction ➔ Dhubulia ➔ Murshidabad ➔ Lalgola.
  - Branch Lines: Naihati to Bandel (via Jubilee Bridge), Barasat to Bongaon (Petrapole border), Barasat to Hasnabad.
- **South Section**:
  - Sealdah ➔ Park Circus ➔ Ballygunge Junction ➔ Dhakuria ➔ Jadavpur ➔ Baghajatin ➔ New Garia ➔ Garia ➔ Narendrapur ➔ Sonarpur Junction.
  - Canning Branch: Sonarpur ➔ Champahati ➔ Ghutiari Shariff ➔ Canning (Sundarbans).
  - Diamond Harbour Branch: Sonarpur ➔ Baruipur ➔ Magrahat ➔ Diamond Harbour.
  - Namkhana / Kakdwip Branch: Sonarpur ➔ Baruipur ➔ Lakshmikantapur ➔ Kakdwip ➔ Namkhana (Bakkhali beach gateway).
  - Budge Budge Branch: Ballygunge ➔ Lake Gardens ➔ Tollygunge ➔ New Alipore ➔ Majerhat ➔ Brace Bridge ➔ Santoshpur ➔ Akra ➔ Nangi ➔ Budge Budge.

### C. South Eastern Railway (Kharagpur Division)
- **Hub**: Howrah (New Complex) & Kharagpur Junction (KGP).
- **Suburban Lines**: Howrah ➔ Tikapara ➔ Dasnagar ➔ Ramrajatala ➔ Santragachi ➔ Maurigram ➔ Andul ➔ Sankrail ➔ Manikpur ➔ Bauria ➔ Chengel ➔ Fuleswar ➔ Uluberia ➔ Bir Shibpur ➔ Kulgachia ➔ Bagnan ➔ Deulti ➔ Kolaghat ➔ Mecheda ➔ Nandakumar ➔ Tamluk ➔ Panskura ➔ Kharagpur ➔ Midnapore.
- **Digha Coastal Line**: Tamluk ➔ Kanthi (Contai) ➔ Ramnagar ➔ Digha Flag Station (DGHA).

### D. Metro Railway Kolkata
- **Green Line (Line 2 — Underwater Metro)**:
  - Route: Howrah Maidan ➔ Howrah Railway Station ➔ BBD Bagh (Mahakaran) ➔ Esplanade (Interchange with Blue Line) ➔ Sealdah Railway Station ➔ Phoolbagan ➔ Salt Lake Stadium ➔ Bengal Chemical ➔ City Centre ➔ Central Park ➔ Karunamoyee ➔ Salt Lake Sector V.
  - Special feature: Passes under the Hooghly river through a 520m twin tunnel, 32 meters below ground level.
- **Blue Line (Line 1 — North-South)**:
  - Route: Dakshineswar ➔ Baranagar ➔ Noapara ➔ Dum Dum ➔ Belgachia ➔ Shyambazar ➔ Shovabazar ➔ Girish Park ➔ Mahatma Gandhi Road ➔ Central ➔ Chandni Chowk ➔ Esplanade ➔ Park Street ➔ Maidan ➔ Rabindra Sadan ➔ Netaji Bhavan ➔ Jatin Das Park ➔ Kalighat ➔ Rabindra Sarobar ➔ Mahanayak Uttam Kumar ➔ Netaji ➔ Masterda Surya Sen ➔ Gitanjali ➔ Kavi Nazrul ➔ Shahid Khudiram ➔ Kavi Subhash.
- **Purple Line (Line 3)**: Joka ➔ Thakurpukur ➔ Sakherbazar ➔ Behala Chowrasta ➔ Behala Bazar ➔ Taratala ➔ Majerhat.
- **Orange Line (Line 6)**: Kavi Subhash ➔ Satyajit Ray ➔ Jyotirindra Nandy ➔ Kavi Sukanta ➔ Hemanta Mukhopadhyay (Ruby More).

---

## 4. Ticketing & Passenger Rules
- **Suburban Local Trains**: Tickets can be booked at booking windows or digitally via Indian Railways' official **UTS on Mobile** app (Android/iOS). UTS tickets require geo-fencing (booking within 20m - 20km from the station platform).
- **Monthly Season Tickets (MST)**: Cost approximately equal to 15 single journeys and allow unlimited travel for 30 days between selected stations.
- **Luggage & Vendor Coaches**: Commuter trains designate specific compartments for daily agricultural vendors, vendors, and heavy goods.
- **Ladies Compartments**: Specific coaches at both ends and middle of 12-coach rakes are reserved exclusively for women passengers.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Synthesis
- **Q: What is the first local train from Howrah to Bandel?**
  - **A**: The first EMU local leaves Howrah at approximately 04:00 AM, with trains running every 10-15 minutes throughout the day until 23:45 PM. Check real-time schedule at https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-to-bandel.
- **Q: How to reach Salt Lake Sector V from Howrah Railway Station?**
  - **A**: Take the Green Line Kolkata Metro directly from Howrah Metro Station (underground below Howrah Railway complex). The ride takes approximately 25-27 minutes directly to Salt Lake Sector V. Timetable: https://banglarail.in/trains-between/howrah-maidan-to-salt-lake-sector-v.
- **Q: What is the train fare between Howrah and Barddhaman?**
  - **A**: Unreserved EMU local train fare is ₹25 for both Main and Chord lines. Superfast/Express general coach fare is ₹50-₹70.
- **Q: Where is Adisaptagram Railway Station located?**
  - **A**: Adisaptagram (Code: ADST) is in Hooghly district, located between Hooghly/Bandel and Mogra on the Eastern Railway Howrah-Barddhaman Main Line. Timetable: https://banglarail.in/station/adst.
